title: Hand Pose Test
description: A webcam-based hand-tracking study that draws hand landmarks and detects a thumb–index pinch in real time.
instructions: Start the preview and allow camera access. Hold your hand in view, then bring your thumb and index finger together to trigger “PINCH!”.

title: Robot Control With AI
description: Control an animated robot over a mirrored live camera view using hand gestures.
instructions: Start the preview and allow camera access. Open palm or no hand: stop. Fist: move forward. Index finger: turn left. Index and middle fingers: turn right. Bring two open palms together to reset, then separate them before resetting again.

title: Firefly & SAM · 3D Window
original: 流萤与萨姆 · 立体机甲窗口
description: An eye-tracked window into a real-time 3D scene. Move your head to reveal depth around Firefly, SAM, a manga backdrop and an armored frame.
instructions: Open the work, choose Control → Camera and allow access. Look straight ahead and recenter, then move gently left and right. Choose a 14- or 27-inch screen preset and adjust the camera offset if needed. Mouse mode is also available. Camera images stay on your device.
